environment.notes: Archil remote uses Python 3 stdlib guest, wall-clock spans API request to JSON response. queueMs includes VM provisioning and mounts, NOT raw Firecracker boot. seq-read uses just-created data and is NOT a cold-cache test. No true CPU stack samples from Archil. Suite ran with up to 4 concurrent microVMs; concurrent calls may contend, so compare against parallel=1 runs before drawing latency conclusions.
